warning: CLASSIFICATION: flood_dataset_classification.csv, flood-positive rows only. Classes are train-only quantiles of people affected, not a surveyed water depth. Rainfall contains repeated filled values. Do not report these metrics as real-world performance.
coverage: Local file flood_dataset_classification.csv. Global coordinates and a year column. No agency or licence is cited in the file. Distance was left out: most values are 0 and the rest are far outside 0–500 km.
label_rule: Flood-positive rows only (occured = 1, which matches Disaster Type 0). Total Affected is the score. scripts/train.py bins it with quantiles (0.4, 0.75) fit on the training split only, then drops it. Deaths, affected, disaster type, and occured are not model inputs.
